name: Tuna Casserole
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 can each of cream of celery soup, cream of chicken soup, and cream of mushroom soup (substitute cream of potato if you don't like mushrooms)
1 bag of frozen vegetables (peas, carrots, and corn)
1 can of fried onion rings, 1 packet potato chips, or 1 small packet corn flakes

steps: Cook egg noodles as directed on package. While boiling water, preheat oven to 400°F.
Drain egg noodles. Mix together all ingredients except fried onion rings. Put in a casserole dish or a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake for 20 minutes.
Sprinkle fried onion topping on top of baked casserole. Bake for an additional 3 minutes, or until fried onion is slightly brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes and serve.
